svg.text: Oak Glen Preserve — Webelos Walkabout Route
Leader map · Main Loop + Conifers of California + Aquatic Ecosystems pond loop
39611 Oak Glen Rd, Oak Glen, CA 92399 · Elevation about 5,000 ft
(strenuous, 1.8 mi round trip — not on this route)
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (openstreetmap.org/copyright).
Trail names follow the Wildlands Conservancy Oak Glen Preserve trail map. Map tracings run short on winding trails;
the Preserve posts the Main Loop at 2 miles. Track the walk with a GPS app on hike day to confirm the distance.
